m: काटाक्ष m. n. (?) (cf. काट), a sort of vessel for holding liquid, Kāṭh. xl, 4.

v: pu॰ kaM jalamawyate prApyate'tra awa--ADAre GaY । 1 kUpe niru॰ । “indraM kutso vftrahaRaM SacIpatiM kAwe nibAhlaH” f॰ 1, 106, 6, “kUwayAsya saMSIryyante SloRayA kAwamarddati” aTa॰ 12, 4, 3, 2 vipamamArge vedadI॰
m: काट अस्, m. (= कर्त from which it is derived, Naigh. iii, 23) deepness, hole, well (Sāy.), RV. i, 106, 6; AV. xii, 4, 3; MaitrS. iii, 12, 12; ĀpŚr. xvii, 2.
काटयवेम m. N. of a commentator on Kālidāsa's Śakuntalā.
काटिप्य mfn. fr. कटिप, g. संकाशादि.

v: na॰ kawukasya BAvaH yuvA॰ aR । kawukarase ।
m: काटुक n. (fr. कटुक) acidity g. युवादि.

v: tri॰ kAwe vizamamArge kUpe vA BavaH yat । 1 vizamamArgaBave 2 kUpaBave ca 3 rudraBede pu॰ । “namaH kAwyAya ca nIpyAya ca” yaju॰ 16, 37, namaH kAwyAya ca gahvarezWAya ca” । “kAwe kUpe vizamamArge vA BavaH” vedadI॰ ।
m: काट्य mfn. being in a hole, VS. xvi, 37 and 44.
